purpose: Synthetic analytic and structural acceptance oracles; no invented real astronomical signs. Only executable-preview cases are run by tests/verify.mjs. Remaining cases constrain future implementations.

cases.domain: t in [0,10] seconds; lambda=10+t/100 degrees; step=1s
cases.oracle: analytic function stays strictly inside Aries
cases.expected: observed-constant=aries; no certificate or probability
cases.failurePrevented: Equal finite samples must not imply certified continuum constancy.

cases.domain: t in [0,10]; lambda=29+t/5; step=1s
cases.expected: variable with aries and taurus; second sign owns exact t=5
cases.failurePrevented: Missing equality or inventing transition precision.

cases.domain: t in [0,10]; lambda=359+t/5 modulo 360
cases.expected: variable with pisces and aries
cases.failurePrevented: Linear min/max error at 0/360 wrap.

cases.domain: t in [0,10); lambda=29+t/10; maxStep=1s
cases.oracle: first Taurus point is excluded at t=10
cases.expected: observed-constant=aries; final evaluated lattice instant t=9.999
cases.failurePrevented: Including the excluded final boundary.

cases.domain: t in [0,10]; lambda=29+t/10
cases.oracle: t=10 is included and exactly 30 degrees
cases.expected: variable=aries,taurus
cases.failurePrevented: Dropping a zero-measure endpoint that changes a universal conclusion.

cases.expected: observed-constant=aries; complete=false
cases.failurePrevented: A rapid between-sample excursion defeats dense-looking finite evidence.

cases.oracle: a Taurus value exists only at tangency t=5.5
cases.expected: observed-constant=aries; complete=false
cases.failurePrevented: Sign-change-only root searches miss a point contact.

cases.domain: location absent; body sign and Ascendant requested
cases.oracle: body longitude defined; chart.angles and houses null
cases.expected: body observed-constant; angle unavailable
cases.failurePrevented: Noon placeholder or invented Ascendant for unknown location.

cases.domain: requested placidus; synthetic chart returns whole
cases.expected: body-house unavailable; issue names substitution
cases.failurePrevented: Whole-sign fallback mislabeled as Placidus.

cases.domain: intervals [0,10] and [5,15], one-second grid
cases.expected: 16 samples, not 22; no probabilities
cases.failurePrevented: Double-counting overlap.

cases.domain: 11 required samples; budget 5
cases.expected: RangeError before engine evaluation
cases.failurePrevented: Silent undersampling or truncated result.

cases.domain: deltaT pinned to 80 seconds
cases.expected: same pinned value received at every instant
cases.failurePrevented: Passing through positions() which cannot receive pinned deltaT.

cases.domain: Sun longitude 0, Moon 54+t; trine target 60 orb 2, t in [0,10]
cases.expected: variable=false,true; equality included
cases.failurePrevented: Implicit/default aspect-orb semantics.

cases.domain: synthetic ephemeris throws at t=5
cases.oracle: one required sample cannot be evaluated
cases.expected: observed values retained; issue recorded; complete=false; finiteDomainEvaluated=false
cases.failurePrevented: Silently dropping a failing sample.

cases.domain: synthetic clock offset +02 before UTC 2000-01-01T00:00Z, +01 from transition; local [01:15,01:45)
cases.expected: UTC [1999-12-31T23:15Z,23:45Z) union [2000-01-01T00:15Z,00:45Z); 3600s duration; no implicit 50/50 branch prior
cases.failurePrevented: Joining endpoints into a continuous interval or dropping later fold.

cases.domain: synthetic clock offset +01 before UTC 2000-01-01T01:00Z, +02 afterward; local [01:30,03:30)
cases.expected: reject by default; exclude-and-report maps UTC [00:30,01:30), reports missing local [02:00,03:00); original domain incomplete
cases.failurePrevented: Silently shifting nonexistent local time.

cases.domain: record 12:00 rounded to nearest 5 minutes, ties toward later mark
cases.expected: support [11:57:30,12:02:30); prior remains none unless supplied
cases.failurePrevented: Treating rounding support as uniform birth-time probability.

cases.domain: synthetic LMT hypothesis at east longitude 75 degrees vs fixed-zone offset +06:00; wall noon
cases.expected: two conditional instants 07:00Z and 06:00Z; neither hypothesis asserted historically true
cases.failurePrevented: Substituting zone-reference meridian for birthplace without evidence.

cases.domain: time fixed; longitude box crosses antimeridian from 179.5 to -179.5; latitude fixed
cases.expected: one-degree region represented; center/corners do not certify interior
cases.failurePrevented: Treating antimeridian box as a 359-degree region.

cases.domain: synthetic f(dt)=30-(dt-50)^2/100 with dt in [49,51] seconds
cases.expected: variable; endpoint-only sampling must not certify constant
cases.failurePrevented: Hidden model-uncertainty change.

cases.domain: same input domain; two declared house models return different house numbers
cases.expected: each model conditional constant under a proper proof; cross-model sensitive; no weighted pooled claim
cases.failurePrevented: Averaging competing house conventions.

cases.domain: claimed certificate partitions [0,10] as [0,5) union (5,10]
cases.expected: checker rejects complete=true
cases.failurePrevented: A measure-zero coverage hole invalidates universal proof.

cases.domain: calendar julian or local 23:59:60 in current profile
cases.oracle: unsupported by inspected rc10 local public interface and Date profile
cases.expected: explicit unresolved/reject; no normalization into Gregorian or next minute
cases.failurePrevented: Silent calendar/timescale conversion.

cases.domain: known feature partition with unresolved duration 2 out of 10 seconds; caller-declared uniform UTC measure
cases.expected: probability intervals retain unknown mass; no renormalization over known 8 seconds
cases.failurePrevented: Discarding unresolved probability mass.
